domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n > 1
k is an integer with 1 <= k <= n
floor is the standard floor of a real number into an integer (defined for all real inputs)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n greater than 1 and all real numbers t: if for all integers k with 1 <= k <= n the equality floor of (k times t) equals k minus 1 holds, then E_n(t) equals H_n minus 1.
quantifier_order: if premise holds for all integers k with 1 <= k <= n

variables.name: n
variables.role: global index parameter; quantified universally with restriction n > 1

variables.name: t
variables.role: real input to the function E_n(t); quantified universally

variables.name: k
variables.role: dummy variable in the premise; universally quantified for the range 1 <= k <= n

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses are introduced; the premise quantifies k universally and the conclusion is an equality for E_n(t)

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t, if floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, then E_n(t) = H_n - 1.
